interpretation_revision: Initial per-column scaling did not reproduce the reference. Frozen processed outputs show a population SD per complete field block and separate train/test column centres. Correction follows intermediate-array evidence, not test-score optimisation. Original run retained.
implementation: SARscope data loading, alignment checks, grid, fields, preprocessing, component selection, fitting, prediction and metrics; NumPy/RDKit/scikit-learn primitives only

data.coordinate_policy: Preserve deposited explicit-H coordinates, validate finite coordinates and stereochemistry, no minimisation or re-alignment
data.redistribution: Fetch data only. Do not bundle upstream SDF or program code.

historical_preprocessing.standardisation: One population SD per field across all 31 molecules and grid points, followed by separate train/test column means. Methods 4.6 field-scaling interpretation checked against frozen numerical outputs. Benchmark-only, transductive; not native validation.
historical_preprocessing.target_mean_diagnostic: A separately labelled oracle-adjusted statistic adds measured test mean minus training mean. Never call it a model prediction or use it in native validation.
historical_preprocessing.selection: SARscope full maximum-q2 search over 1-12 components, original 21 training rows, LOO conditional on the historical representation
historical_preprocessing.prediction: Fit selected count on 21 original training rows; predict all 10 original test rows

native_comparison.warning: Grid is training-only; filtering/scaling/selection refit within CV. This is not expected to reproduce transductive historical scores. All outcomes retained; no test-based model selection.

scope: Independent SEH historical protocol reproduction on a supplied pre-aligned cohort, not original CoMFA, five-field equivalence, new alignment validation or unbiased predictive validation
